findings: Unchanged cache hash_folder reuses path key after source bytes change; only hash_size checked, no content/stat/recipe freshness. Controlled compute adapter called once across two content versions.

Original vectorized pairwise+UnionFind groups0,1,3 at threshold1: endpoints distance2. Duplicate deletion branch later keeps first group member; group membership is not all-pairs qualification or exact identity. No delete branch run.
Original best matcher sentinel9999 fails when true distance16384:nonempty ref gives idx-1,distance9999. hash_size UI/config lacks explicit bound in reviewed entry points.
hex_to_uint64_array zero-pads without logical width metadata; mixed widths can broadcast if one row hasone uint64, rather than reject. Not runtime tested in this step.
Best threshold argument unused; it computes all distances. Pairwise result list materializes every accepted pair and can grow quadratically.
Threshold0 called exact but groups by perceptual hash only; no byte/pixel confirmation before optional deletion.
Copy cluster/group flattens basenames and can overwrite same-name files from distinct source directories; source finding only.
Cache is JSON written directly with open(w), no atomic replacement or concurrent writer coordination; read schema weakly validated.
Image.open not context-managed; no EXIF/ICC/alpha normalization/frame coverage established by imagehash invocation.

Cross overlap loops target hashes and only best_a_idx, omitting other distinct reference hashes within threshold. Pair count and involved-image set can underreport complete overlap; no exhaustive pair oracle in repo.

Folder expansion copies distance/ref from one matched sibling to unmatched siblings; reports do not mark propagated vs directly measured evidence. Classification expansion chooses first encountered label for folder, tie/order behavior not qualified.
After filename overlap filtering removes every target, match_folders still calls build_hash_matrix([]), which numpy.stack rejects; source finding only.
Classification and match tie resolution uses first reference index; hash_folder insertion comes from as_completed, so reference tie selection can vary by worker completion order.
Fallback filename adds a single _dDIST or _dup suffix without retry uniqueness; repeated same names/distances can still overwrite. No copy/move/delete actions executed.
get_images sorted os.walk extension filtering; no file-content sniff until decoder, no explicit per-image decode work or cancellation budgets.
README/illustrations present distance0 as identical and threshold bands as semantic categories, not backed by positive/negative calibration corpus. No automated tests/accuracy fixtures tracked.

Six images are banner, feature table, conceptual hash/threshold diagram, performance graph, pHash pipeline diagram and workflow diagram. They are not application runtime screenshots or independent accuracy samples.
Performance graph claims70x..260x and README75K timing table lack tracked benchmark script/raw data,hardware or frozen dependencies. No speedup accepted.
